exposure: Birth weight category (Small for gestational age [SGA], Low birth weight [LBW], Large for gestational age [LGA])
cohort: The study enrolled 150 exclusively breastfed high-risk neonates, including those who were small for gestational age (SGA), low birth weight (LBW), late preterm, large for gestational age (LGA), or infants of diabetic mothers (IDM), but excluded those requiring NICU admission.
finding: The incidence of hypoglycemia in high-risk newborns was found to be 20.8%, with most cases developing at 2 hours of life and none after 48 hours.
mod_finding: The incidence of hypoglycemia was higher in babies born via C-section (28%) compared to those born via vaginal delivery (10%).

gest_age: Late preterm, Small for gestational age (SGA), Large for gestational age (LGA)
